route.prompt: Which support queue should handle this ticket?

criteria.billing: Charges, invoices, receipts, refunds of subscription fees, failed payments, changing the card on file or the billing address.
criteria.account_access: Cannot log in, password resets, two-factor codes, single sign-on errors, locked or disabled accounts, changing the account email.
criteria.bug: A feature of the product is broken, shows an error, or gives wrong results.
criteria.feature_request: Asks for a capability the product does not have, or a change to how it works.
criteria.data_privacy: Requests to export, correct or delete personal data; GDPR or CCPA questions; data processing agreements; data retention.
criteria.integrations: Connecting or troubleshooting third-party apps and the API: Slack, QuickBooks, Xero, Zapier, webhooks, API keys, rate limits.
criteria.security: Suspected account compromise, unrecognised logins, phishing that impersonates us, exposed credentials, vulnerability reports.
criteria.sales: Buying, upgrading or adding seats, quotes, enterprise pricing, trials, demos, procurement paperwork.

urgency.prompt: How urgent is this ticket? low: a question, idea or feedback with no time pressure. normal: a request or a problem that does not stop anyone working, or has a workaround. high: blocks a person or team's work today with no workaround, or risks a missed payment or legal deadline within days. critical: an outage or data loss affecting many users, or a security breach in progress.
